chemistry_fields.candidate_element_ids: Array of stable element IDs; cardinality follows response contract
chemistry_fields.parts: Array of element or intact-group records with stable part IDs, element/group IDs, positive integer multiplicity, explicit species charge if applicable, and authored role
chemistry_fields.species_charge: Integer charge for the explicitly identified whole species; separate from multiplicity
chemistry_fields.coefficient: Positive integer number of whole formula units only when the task supports coefficients
chemistry_fields.configuration: Parsed subshell/orbital occupancy and preserved raw notation
chemistry_fields.name_response: Preserved learner text and optional structured naming tokens
chemistry_fields.confidence: Optional not_sure, tentative, or confident; not correctness evidence

draft_model.rule: Persist via Campus-supported shape or adapter; do not silently assume history persistence or introduce parallel storage.

activity_response_requirements: Explicit formula_kind where applicable: molecular, empirical, formula_unit, ion, or unsupported scoped type
Explicit species condition: neutral, specified ion charge, or authored ambiguity
Explicit candidate response: single, select_all, accepted_candidate_set, or insufficient_information
Explicit ordering policy and whether order itself is assessed
Explicit normalization and accepted naming/configuration variants
Explicit allowed capabilities and any assessment reference restrictions

invariants.rule: Inspection changes no chemistry draft and submits no attempt.
Each intentional add_atom adds one atom and leaves species charge unchanged.
Atom/group multiplicity, coefficient, net charge, oxidation state, and formal charge remain separate fields and labels.
Intact groups preserve group identity and multiplicity; expanded counts are derived, not a competing editable draft.
Click order is provenance; chemical display follows explicit authored order policy.
Normalization never reduces molecular formulas to empirical formulas or infers ion charge from an atom subscript.
Help is available before attempts and viewing it does not change the answer.
Native grader owns correctness and completion; local validation is structural or explanatory only.
Modal cancellation, reference navigation, and hint Back leave draft content and save revision unchanged.
Submitted attempt revisions are immutable; old feedback cannot overwrite a newer draft.
A network failure is neither an incorrect answer nor completion.
Ambiguous clues use an authored accepted set or insufficiency response; never arbitrary uniqueness.
Identity and activity version isolate drafts and prevent cross-user or cross-activity restoration.
A syntactically valid composition or zero net charge does not prove chemical existence or structural uniqueness.

host_adapter_semantics.load_activity: Obtain versioned activity and allowed response contract
host_adapter_semantics.save_draft: Persist semantic draft against a known revision and expose acknowledgement
host_adapter_semantics.submit_attempt: Submit an immutable draft snapshot with native idempotency identity
host_adapter_semantics.read_attempt: Resolve uncertain timeout result before retrying a potentially completed submission
host_adapter_semantics.read_completion: Use existing course completion semantics; no local replacement
host_adapter_semantics.resolve_draft_conflict: Use native version-protected resolution; never silent overwrite
host_adapter_semantics.navigate: Use native course navigation and actual loss warnings only

safe_after_parse: Normalize supported subscript and superscript glyphs into structured fields
Apply explicitly authored accepted naming spelling variants
never_implicit: Charge inferred from bare atom count
Formula order inferred from tap order
Inferring ionic charge solely from atomic number or mass
Inventing a stable compound from balanced counts
Conflating oxidation state, net charge, and formal charge
formula_normalization.ambiguous_text: Preserve raw input. Fe2 is an atom-count expression under the formula grammar. Fe2+ is ambiguous across common text conventions and requires clarification; accept explicit Fe^2+ or Unicode Fe²⁺ as charge plus two on one Fe. Never infer a missing sign. Formula case remains meaningful: Co differs from CO.
formula_normalization.parse_failure: Retain exact input, identify the unsupported or malformed span, and offer notation help without sending a wrong-grade event.

accessibility.table_navigation: Managed focus, spatial arrows through populated cells, Home/End within row, explicit f-block jump/return, searchable equivalent list
accessibility.live_updates: One concise polite summary per semantic transaction; detailed ledger remains readable on demand
accessibility.reflow: Surrounding controls reflow through 400 percent zoom; inherently two-dimensional periodic table may scroll in a named region

periodic_layout.f_block: Explicit detached-row mapping; connector cells are navigation controls and never element answers
periodic_layout.convention: Use validated curricular layout convention consistently and disclose choices; do not infer family from screen coordinate

adapter_mapping.element_id: Derive stable pwb.element.{atomic_number} after uniqueness validation; never derive from display position
adapter_mapping.group_or_null: elements[].group; preserve null, never coerce to zero
adapter_mapping.layout_convention_id: pwb.layout.detached_series.v1; adapter-owned identifier bound to reference_data.conventions and dataset_version
adapter_mapping.category_id: Optional separately validated curricular category map. Not present in current reference records; omit categorical coloring until available. display_region is a layout region, not a chemical family.

performance_targets_unverified.rapid_activation_test: Ten deliberate activations produce ten additions without dropped or duplicated transactions
performance_targets_unverified.network: No per-hover grade or reference fetch; no duplicate check attempts; no invented cached offline save state
performance_targets_unverified.fallback: Preserve text counts, reference text, and ledger when optional graphics fail

release_gates: Keyboard, screen-reader, touch, zoom and reduced-motion testing
implementation_scope: Design only; no application implementation or deployment is included.

response_part.rule: part_id is an authored stable identifier, not a label copied from an answer key. An activity can require several parts and several instances of a type.

response_envelope.grading: Native grader evaluates components independently under the authored rubric. Required explanations are response parts; optional reflection is separate. Preserve scientifically correct components when another component needs revision. Do not require exact text matching for equivalent reasoning.

response_types.element_id_set: Unordered set of validated element identifiers with authored cardinality
response_types.integer: Integer with explicit unit or semantic label such as electron count, charge, or domains
response_types.boolean: Explicit yes/no proposition tied to an authored prompt
response_types.explanation: Learner reasoning text evaluated semantically against authored rubric
response_types.configuration: Structured subshell occupancy plus original notation, optional shorthand core, and explicit species identity
response_types.orbital_occupancy: Authored orbital IDs with electron occupancy and spin values; total and unpaired count may be separate response parts
response_types.formula: Structured elements/groups/multiplicities, explicit overall charge, formula kind, learner order, and raw input
response_types.formula_set: Named independent formula response parts keyed by authored subquestion IDs; never one overwritten global tray
response_types.chemical_name: Preserved learner text with optional structured naming tokens and authored nomenclature policy
response_types.classification_map: Map from authored item IDs to category IDs; no answers hidden in option values or presentation labels
response_types.comparison: Authored comparison claims or named fields plus reasoning, not a single element picker
response_types.charge_ledger: Explicit species IDs, multiplicities, charge contributions, and overall total
response_types.lewis_graph: Later-gated atom IDs, bonds, lone pairs, unpaired electrons, net charge and formal charge; coordinates excluded from chemistry identity
response_types.domain_summary: Later-gated central atom ID, bonding domains, lone-pair domains, total domains, electron geometry and molecular shape
response_types.insufficient_information: Explicit authored ambiguity response with optional reason and next-clue request

composite_activity_mappings.ui: One persistent draft tray per named subquestion, with explicit tab labels and independent check-component feedback

composite_mapping_rule: These mappings specify supported response shapes, not a declaration that every answer-key field must be entered. At integration, derive required parts from each exact activity prompt and rubric. Canonical-answer aliases and explanatory metadata must not accidentally become required learner fields.

reference_availability.rule: Only show fields present in validated reference data or explicitly sourced extension data. No universal full-element electron configuration or atomic weight coverage is implied.
reference_availability.available: 118 identities/layout; first-20 neutral configurations; selected teaching ions; explicit selected exceptions
reference_availability.missing: Show Not included in this reference set with a scoped lesson/source route; do not fabricate values.
